why: The owner has ruled that no one is recorded as a son of God/YHVH. JHN 19:7 is the accusers' charge.
1SA 16 presents Abinadab (16:8) and David (16:11-13) as sons of Jesse, and David is anointed 'in the midst of his brethren' (בְּקֶרֶב אֶחָיו). No david–abinadab row exists.
1KI 19:16 בֶן־נִמְשִׁי means descendant: Jehu is son of Jehoshaphat son of Nimshi (2KI 9:14), and 'jehu-2 grandson-of nimshi' is already recorded.
LUK 23:34 'Father' is the inverse of son-of-God, which the owner has ruled is not recorded.
The owner has ruled that no one is recorded as a son of God/YHVH (GAL 2:20).
2CH 36:10 אָחִיו is a loose word for kinsman. Mattaniah/Zedekiah was Jehoiachin's uncle (2KI 24:17), and 'mattaniah brother-of eliakim-2' (Jehoiachin's father) already records that.
DEU 11:6 אֱלִיאָב בֶּן־רְאוּבֵן means descendant: Eliab is son of Pallu son of Reuben (NUM 26:8), and 'eliab-2 descendant-of reuben (DEU 11:6)' is already recorded.
